title: Alive Towns
description: Procedural townsfolk who walk between shops, doors and plazas on daily routines, gather in small groups and chat with emotes.

towns.description: Maps to animate; each must be a town of config/wasm/warps.json.

npcs_per_town.description: Townsfolk per town, guards included (at most 999).

seed.description: Changes every name, look and routine.

idle_when_empty.description: Towns without players stand still, and catch up on their routines when someone arrives.

gathering_percent.description: Share of the townsfolk in small groups on the plazas at a time.

player_look_percent.description: Share drawn as players of a job class; the others use the walking NPC sprites.

children_percent.description: Share of children (baby classes and the walking kid sprite).

walk_speed.description: Range of walking speeds, in milliseconds per cell (20 to 1000).
